name: meeple-on-board-cap-one-v1
description: ⭐ THE CAP SWEEP UNDER THE SHIPPED R17 RULES (cut 05/09/2026, the day Dean ruled R17 in). meepleCapPerColour shipped at 2 as a PASSENGER: the amended R4 was built into the handoff v2 arm, carried into R17 and ruled in with it, so the cap of ONE that Dean ruled on 04/09/2026 - against its own measurement, on teach simplicity - was overturned without being re-argued. This overlay and its twin exist so the number can be read under the rules that now ship rather than under the v1 loop it was ruled on. ⚠️ WHAT CHANGED ABOUT THE QUESTION: under the v1 loop the cap was a WASTE dial, boxing 13.45 meeples a game, and cap 2 halved that while lifting the hook 0.37 to 0.40. Under R17 resource spends no longer leave the game at all and the cap boxes 1.14 a game, so it has largely stopped doing economic work and the case for 1 is now almost purely the teach case: one of each colour is a rule a player holds in their head and checks at a glance. THE READING THAT WOULD SETTLE IT: if this arm reads within the noise floor of the shipped default on the hook, the bonus mix and the pool by round, then the cap is free to be chosen on teach grounds alone and Dean's 04/09 ruling should simply be restored. If it does not, the flip bought something and that something has to be named. Read it beside the pool-by-round line and the median supply in the last third, never on the hook alone. THIS ARM IS THE CAP OF ONE, which is the rule CLAUDE.md and the isle-of-farms skill have described since 04/09/2026 and the rule Dean actually ruled. Everything else is the shipped R17 game.
